about_the_game:
SURVIVE. FIGHT. CONQUER.

Lost in a raging sea, a samurai finds himself stranded on an unforgiving island ruled by ruthless pirates. Every choice matters. Will you conquer the island, or will it break you?

A TRUE SAMURAI NEVER SURRENDERS

  • Master Dynamic Sword Combat – Hone your katana skills, parry deadly attacks, counter with precision, and unleash devastating strikes.

  • Survive in the Wild – Hunt, gather resources, craft essential gear, and build shelter to endure the island’s harsh conditions.

  • Face Ruthless Pirates – Challenge merciless foes, each with unique tactics and unpredictable fighting styles.

  • Forge Your Own Path – Engage in intense head-on battles or use stealth to outmaneuver enemies. Your strategy defines your survival.

Real danger. Real survival. Real samurai. Are you ready to claim your destiny?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 370
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

short_description: Lost at sea, a lone samurai finds himself on a wild island. He must fight, adapt, and awaken his warrior spirit to survive.
